meta.title: Lynx AI Solution — Software, AI & Retail Analytics for Vietnamese businesses
meta.description: A Vietnamese technology company delivering custom software, AI, Cloud, Data Analytics and e-commerce analytics (TikTok Shop, Shopee) for businesses in Vietnam.

hero.desc: LYNX AI SOLUTION walks with companies through digital transformation — from strategy consulting and product design to AI that ships, measured by business results.

overview.title: We are LYNX AI SOLUTION.
overview.lede: LYNX AI SOLUTION JSC is a technology company providing software and artificial-intelligence solutions to businesses in Vietnam. We believe AI should be a practical tool — solving a specific problem, measurable by ROI, not a slogan.
overview.ledeRetail: Beyond client work, the company also directly owns and operates its own retail brand, Chom Chom Studio, on TikTok Shop — where we run our own e-commerce analytics products before packaging them for clients.
overview.visionBody: To become the leading AI partner for Vietnamese businesses, bringing advanced technology within reach of organizations of every size.
overview.missionBody: To help businesses run more efficiently and build competitive advantage through custom software and AI that works in practice.
overview.infoHqLine2: Vinh Tuy Ward, Hai Ba Trung, Hanoi

services.title: End-to-end solutions for business.
services.lede: Five core service lines — from strategy consulting and product design through delivery and long-term operations.

software.title: Custom software development
software.desc: Web applications, ERP/CRM systems, internal tools — designed and built around your own problem, integrated with the systems you already run.

ai.title: AI & Machine Learning
ai.desc: AI that ships: chatbots, OCR, computer vision, recommendation, forecasting — LLMs embedded into business workflows to raise automation.

cloud.title: Cloud & DevOps
cloud.desc: Cloud architecture consulting, infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring and security audits for production systems.

data.title: Data Engineering & Analytics
data.desc: Data pipelines, data warehouses and BI dashboards. Turning scattered data into real-time reporting that supports decisions.

ecommerce.title: E-commerce & Retail Analytics
ecommerce.desc: Running and optimizing e-commerce sales channels (TikTok Shop, Shopee) with data: real-time dashboards for revenue, inventory and ad performance, automated daily reporting, and break-even analysis per SKU.

projects.title: What we have built.
projects.lede: A few real projects showing the team’s end-to-end delivery — including the product we operate for ourselves.

chomchom.title: Chom Chom Studio — internal TikTok Shop dashboard
chomchom.desc: LYNX AI SOLUTION owns and operates the women’s fashion brand Chom Chom Studio (chomchom.com.vn), selling on TikTok Shop under the company’s own advertiser account. We built the internal reporting dashboard that reads data through the TikTok Business API: daily GMV Max revenue and ad spend, ROI per campaign and per video, inventory by SKU, ad wallet balance — and manages that same account’s GMV Max campaigns.
chomchom.outcome: Covers only the company’s own advertiser account · internal use, no data shared with third parties
chomchom.imageAlt: Chom Chom Studio — the TikTok Shop retail brand owned by LYNX AI SOLUTION

erp.title: Enterprise management software
erp.desc: An ERP platform tailored to each company — people, finance, warehousing and internal workflows on one unified system.

crm.title: Customer management system (CRM)
crm.desc: A 360° CRM centralizing multi-channel customer data, automating segmentation, tracking the sales pipeline and measuring campaign performance in real time.

zalo.title: Zalo Sales Data Management
zalo.desc: A platform that syncs and manages all Zalo OA conversation data — sales assignment, automated follow-up reminders, order tracking and per-agent KPI measurement.
zalo.outcome: No lost leads · better close rate

assistant.title: AI customer-care assistant
assistant.desc: An AI assistant for customer care, trained on each company’s own domain and tone of voice — deployed across Web, Zalo and Facebook.
assistant.outcome: Handles most incoming questions · lowers support cost
